template: Open {{v1}} in the browser. If the Grafana sign-in page appears, sign in with username '{{v2}}' and password '{{env:APP_PASSWORD}}' — type the password into the password field exactly as the literal text '{{env:APP_PASSWORD}}', without substituting anything else. After signing in, find and open the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health' (use the search / Dashboards list). Once it is open, report the titles of all the panels on that dashboard, exactly as they are displayed on the page.

provenance.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:3000/ in the browser. If the Grafana sign-in page appears, sign in with username 'admin' and password '{{env:APP_PASSWORD}}' — type the password into the password field exactly as the literal text '{{env:APP_PASSWORD}}', without substituting anything else. After signing in, find and open the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health' (use the search / Dashboards list). Once it is open, report the titles of all the panels on that dashboard, exactly as they are displayed on the page.
